core.summary: Implemented the core CLI contracts, dispatch and help, UTF-8 input handling, and upper command. Added the initial registry and README command row. The whole-project build and tests pass with zero warnings.
core.notes: ICommand, ExitCodes, CommandException, InputFile, and App are in src/TextKit/Core/. UpperCommand in src/TextKit/Commands/UpperCommand.cs is the example for other commands. Add each new command directly after UpperCommand in CommandRegistry.All and append its row to the README command table, preserving existing entries.

count.summary: Implemented CountCommand with line, whitespace-delimited word, and normalized-text character counts. Added its registry entry, README row, and tests for output, whitespace, line endings, usage errors, missing files, and registration. The count module check passes with zero build warnings and 10 passing tests.
count.notes: CountCommand is registered in CommandRegistry.All and documented as `count <file>`. It uses InputFile.ReadAllText for words and characters and InputFile.ReadLines for lines.

find.summary: Implemented FindCommand with ordinal and optional ordinal-ignore-case matching, 1-based line-numbered output, and usage validation before file access. Added its registry entry, README row, and tests. The find module build and filtered tests pass with zero warnings.
find.notes: FindCommand is in src/TextKit/Commands/FindCommand.cs and registered exactly once in CommandRegistry.All. It reads lines through InputFile.ReadLines and returns ExitCodes.Ok when no lines match.

freq.summary: Implemented freq word counting, ordering, and --top validation. Added tests, one registry entry, and one README command row. The module check passed: zero build warnings and 19 freq tests passing.
freq.notes: FreqCommand is registered in CommandRegistry.All and uses InputFile.ReadAllText. It writes '<count> <word>' lines with invariant lowercasing and ordinal tie ordering; the default limit is 10.

e2e.summary: Added a nine-line poem sample and a zero-byte empty sample, process-level tests for the specified CLI success and failure cases, and exact-output examples for all four commands in README.md. The required e2e build and test check passed with zero warnings and 13 tests passing.
e2e.notes: The e2e tests are in tests/TextKit.Tests/EndToEnd/TextKitProcessTests.cs. The existing registry and README command rows were already correct and were preserved.
